summary.en: Keywords fly out of the depth toward the camera and past it through a tunnel of faint rings and streaks, looping seamlessly behind a still title.
summary.zh: 关键词从纵深飞向镜头并掠过，穿过淡淡的光环与流线，无缝循环在一行静止的标题后面。

fits: A hook or a lockup that says "a lot of things, all here": a still title over a field of the product's nouns.
notFor: Words that must be read one by one; calm, editorial films such as dossier (the flow never stops); light grounds (the glow and the veil want a dark ground).

intent.en: Say 'a lot of things, all here' without asking anyone to read them: the product's nouns stream out of the depth past the camera, so the viewer reads three or five at a time but feels there are many, behind one still title.
intent.zh: 不要求观众读，也能说清“很多东西，全在这里”：产品的名词从纵深飞向镜头并掠过，观众每次只读到三五个，却感到很多，前面压着一行静止的标题。

content.en: 12–28 short keywords of similar length (en ≤ 18 chars, zh ≤ 6), a few marked for the accent, an optional still title (en ≤ 32, zh ≤ 14) and eyebrow (en ≤ 24, zh ≤ 10).
content.zh: 12–28 个长度相近的短关键词（英文 ≤ 18 字符，中文 ≤ 6 字），挑几个用强调色，可选一行静止标题（英文 ≤ 32，中文 ≤ 14）和眉标（英文 ≤ 24，中文 ≤ 10）。

fits.zh: 说“很多东西，全在这里”的钩子或落版：一行静止标题压在产品名词组成的词场上。

notFor.zh: 要逐个读的词；安静的编辑感片子，如 dossier（流动从不停）；浅色底（光晕和暗幕要暗底）。

pairs.note: the still title line over the tunnel

en: Keep the word count and word length close to the defaults; density scales with the count, and Chinese words need a smaller size or near words fill the frame.
Laps per loop must be a whole number, or the loop does not join.
It is a background layer; turning the words up to full brightness as the subject reads as clutter.
zh: 词数和词长保持在默认量级；词数一变密度整体缩放，中文词要调小字号，否则近处的词占满画面。
每个循环的圈数必须是整数，否则首尾接不上。
它是背景层；把词拉满亮度当主角反而读作杂乱。

upstream.name: 词语纵深隧道
upstream.summary: 22 个关键词按黄金角铺在扁椭圆截面上，沿 z 轴从远处飞到相机前擦身而过，透明度走 [0,1,0.5,0.2,0] 生命曲线，跑满 2 整圈首尾无缝
upstream.use: 关键词云/能力清单的动态背景；片头片尾的"信息量"垫底层；需要纵深穿越感的转场
upstream.energy: 高（全屏持续 3D 位移，画面无一刻静止）
